about: Generated by tools/discover-subranges.mjs; rerun it rather than editing. Named ranges (and, in northeast Washington, high ridges) from GeoNames (geonames.org, CC BY 4.0); relief measured on AWS Terrain Tiles. The Selkirk Mountains entry is centred on Gypsy Peak so the skyline is the Washington crest, not the Idaho GNIS point. tools/build-ranges.mjs builds entries with build:true next to ranges.json and discovered.json.
